column1: # Refusal catalogue of P/02. This is the single source of the refusal rows of N4.
# The first ten columns are the P/01 catalogue columns; word is a backtick-delimited fixed diagnostic/refusal token, or the unquoted - if none is prescribed.
# surface: call (a pure procedure), cli (an operator command), start (process start), process (running process), peer (another owner’s TLS/HTTP check).
# code: a three-digit code is a peer HTTP outcome; exit N is exact; exit !0 is any nonzero code (including 2); - means no numeric code here.
# A start exit 2 is a confirmed unfitness that the supervisor does not restart; a start exit 1 is a read not confirmed within START_WAIT, which it restarts (P/02.4 N1.1 RestartPreventExitStatus=2).
# kind/fields/headers are -: P/02 owns no HTTP response schema. log names required diagnostic subjects or a quoted fixed fragment.
# cause, outcome, diagnostic, caller are explanatory source cells, retained whole; generators MUST NOT infer conditions or extra validation from them.
# word and log constrain only the named outcome. A process control outcome exit 0 (manifest changed) is not a failed installation.
# A peer refusal is governed by the linked role-certificate/peer owner; this table adds no P/02 HTTP door.
